big_case.notes: Routine last-minute capital stay application arising from a successive state postconviction denial; presents a recurring, repeatedly rejected Woodard clemency challenge with no circuit split, no amicus participation, no response call from the Court, and a summary unsigned denial without noted dissent.

central_claims.basis: The Court resolved the application via a standard single-sentence unsigned denial order containing no doctrinal explanation.
central_claims.claim: The application fails the Nken / Barefoot stay standard because Guardado received a clemency proceeding under Woodard, his penalty-phase and postconviction IAC claims are procedurally barred as untimely under Fla. R. Crim. P. 3.851(d), and his 31-day warrant-period claim identifies no denial of notice or opportunity to be heard.
